name: Google Sheets

permissions.description: Explicit bounded HTTPS Sheets REST v4 at sheets.googleapis.com using encrypted externally issued OAuth tokens or public-read API keys. Alternate secret names and selected connection profiles require host authorization. Mutations require exact confirmation; retries zero. Event ingress requires explicit administrator profiles, saved secret references and provider/relay setup. Installation never provisions subscriptions or executes trigger code.

definitions.name: Get Spreadsheet (Direct)
definitions.description: Get Spreadsheet
definitions.documentation:
Get Spreadsheet: GET /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.description: Create Spreadsheet
definitions.documentation:
Create Spreadsheet: POST /v4/spreadsheets. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=CREATE_SPREADSHEET. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.description: Get Spreadsheet By Data Filter
definitions.documentation:
Get Spreadsheet By Data Filter: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:getByDataFilter. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.name: Get Values (Direct)
definitions.description: Get Values
definitions.documentation:
Get Values: GET /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Batch Get Values (Direct)
definitions.description: Batch Get Values
definitions.documentation:
Batch Get Values: GET /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/values:batchGet. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.description: Batch Get Values By Data Filter
definitions.documentation:
Batch Get Values By Data Filter: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/values:batchGetByDataFilter. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.name: Update Values (Direct)
definitions.description: Update Values
definitions.documentation:
Update Values: PUT /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=UPDATE_VALUES. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
Append Values: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}:append. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=APPEND_VALUES. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.description: Batch Update Values
definitions.documentation:
Batch Update Values: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/values:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=BATCH_UPDATE_VALUES. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.description: Batch Update Values By Data Filter
definitions.documentation:
Batch Update Values By Data Filter: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/values:batchUpdateByDataFilter. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=BATCH_UPDATE_VALUES_BY_FILTER. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.name: Clear Values (Direct)
definitions.description: Clear Values
definitions.documentation:
Clear Values: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}:clear. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=CLEAR_VALUES. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

Batch Clear Values: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/values:batchClear. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=BATCH_CLEAR_VALUES. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. definitions.name: Get Developer Metadata (Direct)
definitions.description: Get Developer Metadata
definitions.documentation:
Get Developer Metadata: GET /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/developerMetadata/{metadataId}. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.description: Search Developer Metadata
definitions.documentation:
Search Developer Metadata: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/developerMetadata:search. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.name: Copy Sheet To Spreadsheet (Direct)
definitions.description: Copy Sheet To Spreadsheet
definitions.documentation:
Copy Sheet To Spreadsheet: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/sheets/{sheetId}:copyTo. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=COPY_SHEET. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.description: Batch Update Spreadsheet
definitions.documentation:
Batch Update Spreadsheet: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=BATCH_UPDATE_SPREADSHEET. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.name: Add Sheet (Direct)
definitions.description: Add Sheet
definitions.documentation:
Add Sheet: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=ADD_SHEET. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Delete Sheet (Direct)
definitions.description: Delete Sheet
definitions.documentation:
Delete Sheet: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=DELETE_SHEET. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.documentation:
Duplicate Sheet: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=DUPLICATE_SHEET. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Update Sheet Properties (Direct)
definitions.description: Update Sheet Properties
definitions.documentation:
Update Sheet Properties: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=UPDATE_SHEET_PROPERTIES. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.name: Update Spreadsheet Properties (Direct)
definitions.description: Update Spreadsheet Properties
definitions.documentation:
Update Spreadsheet Properties: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=UPDATE_SPREADSHEET_PROPERTIES. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.name: Insert Dimension (Direct)
definitions.description: Insert Dimension
definitions.documentation:
Insert Dimension: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=INSERT_DIMENSION. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
Delete Dimension: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=DELETE_DIMENSION. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.name: Append Dimension (Direct)
definitions.description: Append Dimension
definitions.documentation:
Append Dimension: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=APPEND_DIMENSION. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
Update Dimension Properties: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=UPDATE_DIMENSION_PROPERTIES. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Auto Resize Dimensions (Direct)
definitions.description: Auto Resize Dimensions
definitions.documentation:
Auto Resize Dimensions: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=AUTO_RESIZE_DIMENSIONS. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Repeat Cell (Direct)
definitions.description: Repeat Cell
definitions.documentation:
Repeat Cell: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=REPEAT_CELL. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Update Cells (Direct)
definitions.description: Update Cells
definitions.documentation:
Update Cells: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=UPDATE_CELLS. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Sort Range (Direct)
definitions.description: Sort Range
definitions.documentation:
Sort Range: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=SORT_RANGE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Add Named Range (Direct)
definitions.description: Add Named Range
definitions.documentation:
Add Named Range: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=ADD_NAMED_RANGE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.
