definitions.name: Find Replace (Direct)
definitions.description: Find Replace
definitions.documentation:
Find Replace: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=FIND_REPLACE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Set Basic Filter (Direct)
definitions.description: Set Basic Filter
definitions.documentation:
Set Basic Filter: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=SET_BASIC_FILTER. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.name: Clear Basic Filter (Direct)
definitions.description: Clear Basic Filter
definitions.documentation:
Clear Basic Filter: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=CLEAR_BASIC_FILTER. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.description: Add Developer Metadata
definitions.documentation:
Add Developer Metadata: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=ADD_DEVELOPER_METADATA. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.description: Delete Developer Metadata
definitions.documentation:
Delete Developer Metadata: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=DELETE_DEVELOPER_METADATA. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.documentation:
Merge Cells: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=MERGE_CELLS. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.description: Unmerge Cells
definitions.documentation:
Unmerge Cells: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=UNMERGE_CELLS. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.name: Google Sheets range.edited Event
definitions.description: Typed event emitted by Google Sheets range.edited.
definitions.documentation: Event output contract for Google Sheets range.edited. Canonical relay contract onf.business.v1 is documented in the package ingress setup. The relay must verify the original provider, persist/normalize the event and then authenticate its HTTPS POST with a separate ONF header token. The decoder never sees provider headers and does not verify provider signatures. Only selected resource fields are emitted. Filters scopeId/resourceId are exact matches. Deduplication keeps the last 64 scoped event IDs and checkpoints on trigger success before downstream completion. Repeated older deliveries can run again; downstream operations must be idempotent. No subscription, relay or secret is provisioned by installation. Provider setup: Deploy a bound Apps Script adapter under the authorized spreadsheet owner and explicitly install edit/change triggers; simple onEdit cannot use services requiring authorization. Script/API writes generally do not fire installable triggers. For edits, extract spreadsheet ID, sheet ID and e.range.getA1Notation(), omitting cell values; map to range.edited. For structural changes map only INSERT_ROW/INSERT_COLUMN/REMOVE_ROW/REMOVE_COLUMN/INSERT_GRID/REMOVE_GRID to structure.changed, with rangeA1=null and sheetId=null when unavailable. onChange EDIT/FORMAT/OTHER produce no structural event. Generate a UUID once per admitted Apps Script event, retain it for retry, set scopeId/resourceId to spreadsheet ID and emit the canonical envelope over HTTPS using the separate relay header token. Treat editor identity and old/new values as unavailable unless explicitly provided.

ingressRequirements.name: Google Sheets verified event relay
ingressRequirements.description: Explicit Apps Script installable-trigger adapter. Accepts the canonical onf.business.v1 envelope only; an external provider-aware relay is required.
setupSteps: Install this reviewed package release; no relay or subscription is installed.
Deploy an independently maintained provider-aware relay which implements the exact provider signature, challenge, authorization and replay rules described below.

Deploy a bound Apps Script adapter under the authorized spreadsheet owner and explicitly install edit/change triggers; simple onEdit cannot use services requiring authorization. Script/API writes generally do not fire installable triggers.

For edits, extract spreadsheet ID, sheet ID and e.range.getA1Notation(), omitting cell values; map to range.edited. For structural changes map only INSERT_ROW/INSERT_COLUMN/REMOVE_ROW/REMOVE_COLUMN/INSERT_GRID/REMOVE_GRID to structure.changed, with rangeA1=null and sheetId=null when unavailable. onChange EDIT/FORMAT/OTHER produce no structural event.

Generate a UUID once per admitted Apps Script event, retain it for retry, set scopeId/resourceId to spreadsheet ID and emit the canonical envelope over HTTPS using the separate relay header token. Treat editor identity and old/new values as unavailable unless explicitly provided.

Emit canonical JSON {contract:"onf.business.v1",provider:"google-sheets",eventType,eventId,scopeId,resourceId,occurredAt,resource}; occurredAt and nullable resource fields must explicitly be null when unavailable. The resource fields and eventType are defined by the selected trigger schema. Preserve eventId across relay retries.
Save a separate relay-to-ONF callback secret; create a header-authenticated ingress profile for this requirement.
Bind the intended trigger node, configure the relay with its HTTPS callback URL, then deliberately enable workflow and entry.
Review relay limits, delivery identifiers, retries and downstream idempotency; test explicitly before production use.

Select saved node entry mode webhook explicitly; package metadata does not infer it. Create/select a profile for this exact installed requirement (installation.id + "/verified-provider-relay"), bind node.trigger.ingress.profileId, save the graph and deliberately enable workflow and entry only when setup is complete.
